context: Sho-child and Ren make a paper airplane together.
purpose: Adult and child quiet bonding through small craft.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 蓮にいちゃん、紙ヒコーキ作って!
lines.en: Ren-nii, make a paper plane with me!
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious request. Slight upward lilt on the name. Quick tempo, eager without being demanding. The specific hope of a six-year-old who believes this person can do anything.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Warm, immediate agreement. Gentle slight smile in the voice. No hesitation — he's already mentally shifting into present tense with this kid. Patient ease.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet concentration. Not frustrated — genuinely puzzling it out, thinking aloud. Slows down, studies the fold. The soft voice of a child working hard and not quite there yet.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ゆっくり、丁寧に折ろうね。
lines.en: Go slow, take your time with it.
lines.style: Soft, steady instruction. Not lecturing — sitting beside him. Each word gets a small beat. The tone of someone who knows how hands work at this age and isn't worried about mistakes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Unrestrained joy on the opening word. Brightness peaks on the repeated 「look》. Fast, breathless delivery. Pure unselfconscious triumph of a child who made something work.
